PowerShellfunction Process-Topic { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SearchTerm, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ApiKey ) try { $searchResult = Invoke-DoubaoSearch -SearchTerm $SearchTerm -ApiKey $ApiKey $rawFile = Save-RawSearchResult -SearchTerm $SearchTerm -SearchResult $searchResult if ($SearchOnly) { Write-LearnLog "SearchOnly 已启用，跳过 Ollama 提取：$SearchTerm" return [pscustomobject]@{ topic = $SearchTerm status = "searched" raw_file = $rawFile card_count = 0 error = $null } } $prettyJson = $searchResult.parsed | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 $prompt = New-ExtractionPrompt ` -SearchTerm $SearchTerm ` -RawSearchJson $prettyJson ` -RawFilePath $rawFile Write-LearnLog "开始 Ollama 提取：$SearchTerm" $ollamaOutput = Invoke-OllamaExtraction -Prompt $prompt $jsonArrayText = Extract-JsonArrayText -Text $ollamaOutput $cards = @(Convert-ToCards ` -JsonArrayText $jsonArrayText ` -SearchTerm $SearchTerm ` -RawFilePath $rawFile) # 修复点 1： # 统一使用 -NotePropertyName / -NotePropertyValue，避免 -NoteProperty 缩写歧义。 foreach ($card in $cards) { if (-not $card.PSObject.Properties["search_term"]) { $card | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "search_term" -NotePropertyValue $SearchTerm } else { $card.search_term = $SearchTerm } if (-not $card.PSObject.Properties["raw_file"]) { $card | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "raw_file" -NotePropertyValue $rawFile } else { $card.raw_file = $rawFile } if (-not $card.PSObject.Properties["source_api"]) { $card | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "source_api" -NotePropertyValue "doubao_search_api" } else { $card.source_api = "doubao_search_api" } if (-not $card.PSObject.Properties["found_at"]) { $card | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "found_at" -NotePropertyValue $DateName } else { $card.found_at = $DateName } if (-not $card.PSObject.Properties["learned_at"]) { $card | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "learned_at" -NotePropertyValue (Get-Date).ToString("o") } else { $card.learned_at = (Get-Date).ToString("o") } } $cardCount = @($cards).Count if ($cardCount -gt 0) { Append-CardsJsonl -Cards $cards Write-LearnLog "已入库卡片：$cardCount；主题：$SearchTerm" } else { Write-LearnLog "Ollama 未提取到卡片：$SearchTerm" "WARN" } Update-DailyIntel ` -SearchTerm $SearchTerm ` -Cards $cards ` -RawFilePath $rawFile # 修复点 2： # 所有返回路径都显式返回 card_count，默认值为 0。 return [pscustomobject]@{ topic = $SearchTerm status = "ok" raw_file = $rawFile card_count = [int]$cardCount error = $null } } catch { Write-LearnLog "主题处理失败：$SearchTerm；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" try { Ensure-DailyIntelFile Add-Content -Path $DailyIntelFile -Value @( "" "### 搜索主题失败：$SearchTerm" "" "- 时间：$(Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")" "- 错误：$($_.Exception.Message)" "" ) -Encoding UTF8 } catch { Write-LearnLog "写入每日失败记录也失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } return [pscustomobject]@{ topic = $SearchTerm status = "failed" raw_file = $null card_count = 0 error = $_.Exception.Message } }}
PowerShell# 主循环统计修复版：确保每个 result 都有 card_count，且无法转换时按 0 处理。$results = @()foreach ($topic in $SearchTopics) { $result = Process-Topic -SearchTerm $topic -ApiKey $apiKeyInfo.Value if ($null -eq $result) { $result = [pscustomobject]@{ topic = $topic status = "failed" raw_file = $null card_count = 0 error = "Process-Topic 返回 null" } } if (-not $result.PSObject.Properties["card_count"]) { $result | Add-Member -NotePropertyName "card_count" -NotePropertyValue 0 } if ($null -eq $result.card_count) { $result.card_count = 0 } try { $result.card_count = [int]$result.card_count } catch { $result.card_count = 0 } $results += $result Start-Sleep -Seconds 2}$okCount = @($results | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "ok" }).Count$searchedCount = @($results | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "searched" }).Count$failedCount = @($results | Where-Object { $_.status -eq "failed" }).Count$cardCount = 0foreach ($result in $results) { if ($result.PSObject.Properties["card_count"] -and $null -ne $result.card_count) { try { $cardCount += [int]$result.card_count } catch { $cardCount += 0 } }}Write-LearnLog "流程完成：ok=$okCount, searched=$searchedCount, failed=$failedCount, cards=$cardCount。"
